description.zh: 目标实体ID，可参考ListTables / ListColumns 接口返回的表/字段ID，以及自定义实体ID。
description.en: The ID of the destination entity. This can be a table or column ID returned by the `ListTables` or `ListColumns` API, or the ID of a custom entity.

description.zh: 目标实体名称，模糊匹配。
description.en: The name of the destination entity. This parameter supports fuzzy matching.

description.zh: 是否返回血缘关系信息，默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to include lineage relationships. Default: false.

description.zh:
排序方向，默认为Asc，枚举值，当前支持
- Asc 升序
- Desc 降序
description.en:
The sort order. Default: `Asc`. Valid values:

- `Asc`: ascending

- `Desc`: descending
The page number to retrieve. Default: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，默认为10，最大为100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default: 10. Maximum: 100.

description.zh: 排序字段，默认为Name，按照血缘实体名称排序。
description.en: The field to sort the results by. The default is `Name`, which sorts by entity name.

description.zh: 源实体ID，可参考ListTables / ListColumns 接口返回的表/字段ID，以及自定义实体ID。
description.en: The ID of the source entity. This can be a table or column ID returned by the `ListTables` or `ListColumns` API, or the ID of a custom entity.
The name of the source entity. This parameter supports fuzzy matching.

title.zh: 查询数据地图实体血缘列表

descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks标准版及以上版本才能使用。
2. 本接口主要查询当前实体有哪些上/下游实体，以及实体间的血缘关系
descriptions.en:
1. To use this API, you must purchase DataWorks Standard Edition or a later edition.

2. Use this API to query the upstream and downstream entities of a specific entity and their lineage relationships.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-lineages --src-entity-id maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name --dst-entity-id dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name --src-entity-name srcName1 --dst-entity-name dstName1 --need-attach-relationship false --sort-by Name --order Asc --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListLineages --region cn-hangzhou --Order Asc --SrcEntityId 'maxcompute-table:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name' --SrcEntityName srcName1 --PageSize 10 --DstEntityName dstName1 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy Name --DstEntityId 'dlf-table::catalog_id:database_name::table_name' --NeedAttachRelationship false
